sources.notes: Caliper measurements supplied in the design brief.
Converter body dimensions; wire and bend zones are separate keep-outs.

Requirements the material must satisfy: indoor use, handled and occasionally dropped, no sunlight, no sustained load, a lid snap fit that must recover at every opening. Family selected from those requirements; no specific product is chosen, so generic PETG behavior is the conservative assumption and no numeric property is claimed.

Unvalidated conservative starting values for wall thickness, clearance, printed fit, and cable departure on this printer/material pair. Nothing here is measured evidence, so every parameter pointing at this source stays provisional; printing Validation/PD Fit Coupon and measuring it, or measuring the actual cable, is what replaces it.

material_decision.rationale: The lid snap rim deflects at every opening and must recover; PETG has the toughness and strain recovery for a repeatedly deflected snap, where PLA would be brittle at the snap root and crack after a few cycles. Nothing here needs heat, UV, or sustained-load resistance beyond PETG, so the tougher families are not warranted. Family only: the specific product is not chosen, so every material-dependent number stays provisional.
unresolved_risks: No formulation is named, so no data-sheet number backs any material-dependent value.
fab_fit_clearance is a hypothesis until PD Fit Coupon is printed and measured on the machine that will make the parts.
Snap-rim strain and cycle life are unverified; the coupon proves the pocket fit, not the snap.

parameters.name: src_ekylin_length
parameters.description: Measured converter body length, excluding flexible leads.

parameters.name: clr_rigid_xy
parameters.description: Per-side clearance around rigid electronic bodies; a starting value, not yet confirmed against a printed part.

parameters.name: clr_rigid_z
parameters.description: Vertical clearance above rigid electronic bodies; a starting value, not yet confirmed against a printed part.

parameters.name: fab_wall_thickness
parameters.description: Nominal PETG enclosure wall thickness. A bare '2 mm wall' is folklore until it is reconciled with the nozzle width and the actual load; confirm both before settling it.

parameters.name: fab_fit_clearance
parameters.description: Per-side printed sliding-fit clearance. Printer- and material-specific; settle it by printing and measuring PD Fit Coupon, never by reusing this number.

parameters.name: des_corner_radius
parameters.description: Exterior corner radius; adjustable without changing fit evidence.

parameters.name: pack_usb_c_straight_departure
parameters.description: Conservative initial straight cable-departure keep-out; confirm with the actual cable.

orientation.rationale: The flat floor sits on the plate, which is why support_policy is 'none' here, and keeps the seam off the mating rim. Whether the part actually needs supports is a slicer result, not a manifest claim.

protected_features.description: Top rim mates with the lid; keep it support-free and unscarred.
USB-C insertion opening must stay dimensionally clean.

orientation.rationale: Printing the lid top-down keeps the visible outer face against the plate and the snap rim accessible.

protected_features.description: Snap rim engages the base; supports must not touch it.

orientation.rationale: Coupon prints flat in the same orientation as the base pocket it validates.

protected_features.description: Pocket walls are the measured fit surfaces.
